IN THE UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
FOR THE NORTHERN DISTRICT OF ILLINOIS
EASTERN DIVISION

RIDGELINE AEROSPACE COMPONENTS, INC.,
Plaintiff,
v.
HALLORAN PRECISION CASTINGS, LLC,
Defendant.

Case No. 1:26-cv-04412
Hon. Marisol Aguirre-Vance

NOTICE OF RULE 30(b)(6) DEPOSITION OF HALLORAN PRECISION CASTINGS, LLC

TO: Halloran Precision Castings, LLC, and its attorney of record.

PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that, pursuant to Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 30(b)(6), Plaintiff Ridgeline Aerospace Components, Inc. will take the deposition of Defendant Halloran Precision Castings, LLC on September 17, 2026 beginning at 9:30 a.m. Central Time, at the offices of Tremaine & Okonkwo PLLC, 1201 Third Avenue, Suite 3200, Chicago, Illinois 60602, and by simultaneous videoconference. The deposition will be taken before an officer authorized to administer oaths, will be recorded stenographically and by audio-visual means, and will continue from day to day until completed.

Defendant shall designate one or more officers, directors, managing agents, or other persons who consent to testify on its behalf about the matters described below, and shall state for each designee the matters on which that person will testify. Counsel have conferred in good faith about the number and description of these matters as Rule 30(b)(6) requires, and will continue to confer.

MATTERS FOR EXAMINATION

1. Defendant's inspection, testing, and acceptance procedures for the castings supplied under the supply agreement dated March 2, 2023, for the period January 1, 2023 through December 31, 2025.

2. Defendant's AS9100 quality management system as it applied to the lots identified in Plaintiff's First Set of Requests for Production, Request No. 7, for the same period.

3. Defendant's document retention and destruction practices for inspection records, for the same period.

4. The identity and role of each person who participated in the decision to ship the lots identified in Request No. 7.

5. Defendant's communications with Plaintiff concerning nonconformity, cure, and replacement between January 1, 2024 and the date of this notice.

DOCUMENTS TO BE PRODUCED

Pursuant to Rules 30(b)(2) and 34, Defendant shall produce at or before the deposition the documents described in Schedule A to this notice, which are limited to the matters for examination above.

Dated: August 14, 2026

TREMAINE & OKONKWO PLLC

/s/ Adaora Okonkwo
Adaora Okonkwo
Attorneys for Plaintiff

CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE

I certify that on August 14, 2026 I served the foregoing notice on counsel for Defendant through the Court's electronic filing system.
